supersession_reason: Before any #428 scoring, executable feasibility validation showed that the 2017 history contains 104 baseline trade opportunities under the frozen outer-2019-2020 inherited model, below the preregistered 100 meta-train plus 50 calibration minimum. V3 keeps the same candidate grid, outer evaluations, evidence wall, and promotion gate, but makes learned meta-confidence ineligible for 2018 scoring and the outer-2019-2020 selection. Learned meta-confidence becomes eligible from the 2019 policy score onward, and outer-2021-2022 selection compares every eligible candidate on the common 2019-2020 score years.

frozen_handoff.reason: issue427 retained exactly six development advantages; OI remained sign-unstable and conditional only

chronology.selection_rule: for each outer, configuration selection may consume only the preregistered common score years strictly before the outer start; rolling diagnostics for a score year fit thresholds, state maps, meta-label models and calibrators only on earlier records. The inherited model and representation choices are themselves adaptive inner-development choices, so rolling policy diagnostics are selection evidence rather than clean confirmation evidence.
chronology.outer_2019_policy_support: 2017 history supports state/simple-gate fitting but has only 104 baseline trade opportunities, below the frozen 150-row meta train-plus-calibration minimum. Learned meta-confidence is therefore preregistered ineligible for the 2018 score and outer-2019-2020 selection; this ineligibility counts against the candidate budget.
chronology.outer_2021_policy_support: By the 2019 score, prior 2017-2018 history supplies 226 baseline trade opportunities under the frozen outer-2021-2022 inherited model. All candidate families are therefore compared on the common 2019-2020 policy-score years before outer-2021-2022.

signal_state_contract.transform_rule: use the issue427 lagged transformed value for each inherited selected representation; jump intensity and vol-of-vol use the issue427 PIT-safe derived definitions
signal_state_contract.state_threshold: median fitted on development trade opportunities strictly before the scored year or outer
signal_state_contract.favored_state: for each signal choose high or low state by higher prior development net trade utility after round-trip costs
signal_state_contract.favored_fraction: eligible retained signals currently in their prior-favored state divided by eligible retained signals

regime_contract.joint_state: 2x2 low/high state using medians fitted only on earlier development opportunities
regime_contract.favorable_regime: joint states with positive earlier-development mean net trade utility and at least 30 base trade opportunities
regime_contract.persistence_semantics: same joint state on consecutive decision origins

confidence_contract.model_disagreement: selected issue427 model versus inherited issue425 matched model on identical origins
confidence_contract.trade_label: baseline forecast-sign trade has strictly positive realized gross PnL minus one round-trip cost
confidence_contract.calibration: chronological Platt calibration: fit meta model on earliest 75% of earlier development trade opportunities and fit scalar logistic calibrator on latest 25%; never use rows from the scored year or outer

open_interest_lane.representation_rule: inherit each issue448 nested-selected OI representation without reselection

selection.comparison_years: use chronology.selection_years_by_outer so every candidate competing for an outer is ranked on the same policy-score years
selection.ineligible_candidate_handling: record the attempt with status=ineligible and reason; it counts against the frozen candidate budget but cannot enter ranking until it has scores for every comparison year
selection.baseline_comparison: same rows, same selected issue427 model forecast, same execution/cost/risk assumptions; only TRADE versus ABSTAIN admission changes
